notes.title: Version 2.2.3 Released
notes.notes:
A small update today. Tweaked the ratings notification panels. Also added Steam Cloud support so if you play the game on two different computers, both computers have your game progress.  Work continues on art assets and voice for upcoding releases, including a whole new picture set for Faith, the youngest child of Noah and Hannah.

[b]Coming up next: [/b]ASMR Hot Springs level

[b]And then: [/b]Chapter 5!

[h1]Minor Features[/h1]
* Added Steam Cloud sync support.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
* Reworked the ratings notification panels so they don't get stuck on the screen.

notes.title: Version 2.0.11 Released
notes.notes:
We're back! Sorry for the long delay. We had to go back and retool some things, fixed some bugs in our code with game saving that needed to happen before we go forward, looked at Chapters 1-3 and made them a little better, realized our plan for Chapter 5 was bad, so we are rewriting it. But now we're on track once again, and Chapter 4 is just around the corner!

We have added a new picture set: "Angeli's Choice".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301659/07f0c4f54e6a87894abb9bdfa84cda26ca220601.jpg[/img]
It tells the heartwarming story of Angeli's adventures in high school with her not-boyfriend crush at the galaxy-famous Bergström Academy. These puzzles are easier than other picture sets. Fun for new players.

Introducing Puzzle Buddies! The daughters in your party can now help you with puzzles! Each character has their own power that can solve tiles for you. You can only use them a few times, so spend them wisely. Watch for these new gameplay mechanics starting in Chapter 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301659/2eabfae95fcb72ce2c7cca744070edddf62aede8.jpg[/img]
ASMR Mode now has a new, much more ASMR-y tileset named Clockwork. Thanks to ASMRSurge for his fantastic sound design on this! The original Chips tileset is also available for you to play in Picture and Random modes.

[b]NOTE:[/b] This release invalidates older campaign saves. Sorry about that. We had to switch to a new format to address design issues. (Picture, Random, and ASMR Modes are unaffected.) For all you early adopters who completed levels, you will get free Puzzle Solves so you can speed through the puzzles you already did. Watch for the Solve button to use this feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301659/32ed348eec442b9c00076ea4bd80b9a6bfdf526c.jpg[/img]
Thanks for your support for our game during Early Access!

Coming soon: Chapter 4, Angela's Rings picture set, Hot Springs ASMR level.

[h1]Major Features[/h1]
* Angeli's Choice picture set added.
* Puzzle Buddy game mechanic added.

[h1]Minor Features[/h1]
* ASMR Mode has a new tileset with sounds from ASMRSurge!
* Noah and Angelon case counters added to ASMR Mode.
* Additional dialogue options added to the scene in Noah's quarters.
* Campaign no longer bops you out to menu after each chapter. They now flow directly into each other.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
* Incremental improvements to effects, movies, character placements and timings in Chapters 1-3.
* Better Noah departure in the Chapter 1 "love" scene.
* Better voice effect for remote Hannah during the birthing chamber scene.
* Noah no longer hides the cool monitors during the Angelon build sequence.
* Better cut on the final scene in Chapter 1.
* Enpro Shield effect updated in Chapter 3.
* [b]New game save format.[/b] Old campaign game saves are incompatible. Players who have broken saves get some free Puzzle Solves to make up for it.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
* Tutorial 2 and 3 no longer steal hints from you.
* "Apologize to 129" objective is no longer hidden if you yell at her.

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
* Clockwork tileset is missing a puzzle completion jingle.

notes.title: Version 1.4.4 Released
notes.notes:
Chapter 3 is finally here! We continue the adventure as Noah and Number Two brave a burning forest to find Meryl.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301659/5b25d186fc866b2250ec4b5c55373345c28eec4b.png[/img]

We continue to iterate on the artwork as well. Chapter 2 will get improved next release and several more tilesets are in the works. Two more picture sets telling the story of the twins Angeli and Angela are also coming soon. 

[h1]Minor Features[/h1]
* New Ancient tileset is now unlockable by playing Chapter 3.
* The journal People tab now lists character details.
* Ratings interpretations in the Ratings tab improved.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
* ASMR tileset renamed to Chips and reskinned.
* Better transitions and early guidance in Chapter 1.
* New icons for objectives.
* Autosave notifications restyled.
* General scripting standardization and improvements.
* Added a drop shadow to the logo to make it pop.

notes.title: Version 1.3.21 Released
notes.notes:
Chapter 3 is just a week or two away! We wanted to be done by our 20% off sale today but alas the development gods don't like us this week.  But we will release Chapter 3 before year end, gods willing.

In the meantime we deployed a patch today that continues to improve the game experience. 

We have added the Journal feature on the pause menu that explains the current objectives in the campaign and also what all the ratings bars mean.  We're trying to make it clear what the objectives are and make the effects of player choices more understood beforehand, so that you can be more strategic about the decisions you make.

Also check out the welcome message button on the main menu screen. Its funny and we hope it shows our appreciation for you getting our game early. Helps us out a lot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301659/e8a68f0449dbb5fe37971465fa6d8c49a14f7bb4.png[/img]

Changes from v.1.3.19 to 1.3.21

[h1]Minor Features[/h1]
* Added campaign journal panel on the pause menu screen (partial functionality).
* Added fun welcome message for our customers on the main menu. Check it out!
* Campaign objectives are now displayed in notifications and in the Journal.


[h1]Changes[/h1]
* Added an additional small puzzle early on in Chapter 1 on feedback that the initial cut scenes (9 minutes worth) is too long.  The initial puzzle breaks that up now.
* Chandler now has a voice and lines in Chapter 1. What do you think?

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
* Fixed a bug that can make game save thumbnails black or missing.
* Fixed a bug that could prevent the Restart button from being enabled for chapters you have already unlocked.

notes.title: Version 1.3.19 Released
notes.notes:
Chapter 3 work continues. We hope to release it at Christmas. But we wanted to put out this small patch first that fixes a few bugs reviewers and players have reported.

[h1]Minor Features[/h1]

* Hint system will now fix up to five mistakes made on the puzzle per hint.  If no mistakes are found, then it will find a deduction you can make like usual.  Hopefully this will make Hints much more useful for new players.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

* Fixed a soft-lock that can occur when loading saved games in the campaign that were saved during a puzzle.

notes.title: Version 1.3.18 Released
notes.notes:
Work continues on Chapter 3. All the voice is recorded now and in the process of being mastered.  In the meantime we keep moving forward with fixes and quality of life improvements

Changes from v1.3.13 to 1.3.18

[h1]Minor Features[/h1]
* Tutorial 3 is now available.
* Tile flagging is now mouse draggable.
* Options is now accessible from the pause menu.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
* Tweaked tutorial 2 and 3 animations.
* Radio uses a new channel with voice volume.
* Implemented audio "ducking" when radio and characters talk at the same time, improving audio clarity.
* Hot for Sensei achievement moved to tutorial 3

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
* Fixed portrait narration soft-lock.
* All narrations now have Auto turned on.
* Tutorial puzzles, notifications and particle effects no longer leak into the background.
* Puzzle HUD buttons no longer leak when exiting picture puzzles.
* Fixed Auto button being highlighted incorrectly (no, really, its fixed this time).
* Game expiration no longer causes a soft-lock.

notes.title: Version 1.3.14 released
notes.notes:
Thanks for all the great feedback!  We have lots more tweaking to do on the campaign story telling. Also a couple big bugs to nail down still. We learned a lot from the response to chapters 1 and 2. We are retooling chapter 3 based on this info. Stay tuned!

Changes from v1.3.8 to 1.3.13

[h1]Minor Features[/h1]
* Chapter 1 now quIcksaves before each major choice.
* Picture puzzle menu now highlights clickable picture options on mouse over.
* Auto setting is now remembered across saves reliably.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
* Angelon 947 no longer born naked. Temporary fix while we decide on how to visualize this better.
* Added walk animations. No more hoverboard for Noah and Hannah.
* Removed overhead intercom from chapter 1 hallway scene and replaced it with Gargoyle conversation.
* Inserted overhead intercom in last puzzle in chapter 1 when difficulty setting is on hard.
* Auto mode now can't be turned off during all puzzles, preventing a soft-lock when dialog occurs in puzzles and Auto setting is off.
* Credits update.

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
* Fixed many animations in Chapter 1 and 2.
* Fixed SFX channel mixer assignment. The slider might even work now.
